title: Slay the Spire Clone
summary: A deckbuilder combat engine in Unity 6: a FIFO action queue that can pause for player input, typed buff hooks, data-driven cards with custom Inspector tooling, procedural maps, and versioned saves covered by EditMode tests.
image_alt: Card-driven combat in the Slay the Spire clone

title: Balatro Clone
summary: A poker roguelike study: rank and suit hand evaluation, coroutine-staged scoring the player can follow card by card, ScriptableObject-driven blinds and hands, and shader-based card presentation.
image_alt: Poker cards and scoring in the Balatro clone

title: UnderWatch
role: Team of 3 · lead programmer (32 of 39 commits)
summary: A BOOOM Jam 2026 game in Unity 6 URP: watch prisoners through surveillance feeds by day, defend the camera room at night. ScriptableObject prisoner actions, per-day schedule and evidence assignment, night attack routes, a save system, and a PS1-style post-process render feature.
image_alt: UnderWatch surveillance view: a fisheye camera feed of two prisoners in the gym, with the camera map and power, handcuff, and coffee meters

title: GameDev Hub
summary: A full-stack platform for publishing and discovering games: React client, Express API, a Prisma/PostgreSQL data model, S3 uploads, Passport auth with Discord linking, and a live Discord gateway relay over WebSockets.
image_alt: GameDev Hub catalog reconstructed locally with sample records

title: Multithreaded Run-Length Encoder
summary: A concurrent compression tool in C: a pthread worker pool pulls chunks from a mutex-guarded task queue, encodes them in parallel, and a stitcher joins results in order. Its sibling lab is a FAT32 undelete tool that recovers deleted files, including SHA-1-verified and non-contiguous cases.

title: AI Resume Factory
build_note: Built with AI coding agents; the repository keeps its AGENTS.md.
summary: Job-application automation: scrapes job boards and Gmail alerts, tailors a resume per posting with a local Ollama or OpenAI model, renders PDFs with Playwright, and syncs results to Drive, Notion, and Discord. Ships with CI tests and lint.
